Name: (CP) Solennial's Seasonal Alex Portraits
Author: lightstxrs
Description:
Update 1.0.2:
﻿Last time I said that I would be adding seasonal portraits and here it is! Sets of Portraits for each season with an outdoor version for Winter! :)
I'm planning on adding a spouse specific set of seasonal portraits where each outfit will contain a Mermaid Pendant. I also plan on making Alex's seasonal character sprites once I learn how to edit sprites with CP.
Enjoy :)

Requirements: HD Portraits and Content Patcher

Note: If you are also a fellow portrait uploader, I can help you set up your own mod for your portraits using HD Portraits.

Note 2: The picture of the sets are arrange as following: Spring, Summer, Fall, Winter, and Winter Outdoors.

Compatibility:
No known incompatibilities
If there are, please send it into bug section. Thank you.

Hello! This is a portrait sheet for Alex. I've been studying CP and I have figured it out. I've also made the switch from Portraiture to HDPortraits since the Platonymous Toolkit, which is needed by Portraiture, can be quite unstable and makes the game slower. I also think that HDPortraits helps with the issue of multiple mods trying to load into the same file that my mod modifies. I encourage you to also make the switch to HDPortraits :).

This is inspired by DCBurger's portraits however I must say that the drawings I have here are made from scratch! I have not modified nor will I distribute their work for it is against their copyright rules.

If there are any problems or issues, please contact me at charlesmedina28@gmail.

Downloads.Description:
Requires HD Portraits and Content Patcher

Portraiture not needed

5 sets of Portraits per season with an outdoor version for Winter
